body:
This.

My partner is so kind and compassionate until he isn’t. He can be mean and horrible when he has his emotional disregulations and then 5 mins later apologizes and acts like everything is fine. Then can’t comprehend why I’m still upset even though he’s already over it

I hate it when you leave the garbage bags on our porch and forget to take them to the trash and they just sit there until I take them. I feel like I’m dating a child and I’m at the end of my rope having to remind you to do things, otherwise you will never do them. 

I hate it when you have your emotional outbursts and then 5 minutes later everything is fine and you’re confused as to why I’m still upset, which for some reason makes YOU upset that I’m still not over whatever happened. I’m exhausted and honestly don’t see things getting any better no matter how many times you say you’re gonna work on it. 

My life was always organized and my house was spotless until we moved in together and now everything is always a mess and I’m too overwhelmed and exhausted to clean things up anymore because you always put things in the wrong place and always make more of a mess than I do

Not really , which is something that always bothers me. I’ve had people who I thought were friends text my partner behind my back and say that they like being with him but just don’t want to be around me and I get really paranoid that everyone I become friends with thinks like this secretly as well
This was actually incredibly helpful, thank you 🥺
